title: The verdict seal proof reads the mount table itself
intention: The verdict machine's seal proof reads the mount table itself instead of importing the tester's private _mount_points, so nothing in codemother reaches into the tester off its public interface.
why: Measured 2026-10-09 during d80360545e91's tester reseal: test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py::test_no_foreign_row_lands_on_the_tester reds with '1 reach(es) into the tester: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py:99 cairn.devices.tester.isolation'. The reach was written by 68cef2ddd8ef (052dc486, 2026-10-07). It blocks d80360545e91's criterion 3 (every other tester proof stays sealed green).
traces_to: RULE 1 (Akien, 2026-10-01: every component talks to every other only through its public interface) and Law 9 (a deterministic red stands until fixed)
how: Replace the tester import in the verdict seal proof with the proof's own six-line /proc/self/mountinfo read, and add a tooth asserting encapsulation_breaches carries no row from that proof.
falsifier: Falsifier: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py under PROVES {'68e897fc74b8': {'1','2'}}: (1) a new tooth test_the_proof_reaches_no_device_off_its_interface asserts that cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector.encapsulation_breaches(repo root) carries no row whose file is this proof; (2) tooth test_an_instrument_goes_to_the_sealed_exec_and_nowhere_else keeps its assertions and reads the mount table through the proof's own _mount_points() (field 5 of /proc/self/mountinfo), and the four 68cef2ddd8ef teeth stay green. Predict before the build: tooth (1) reds naming 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py:103 cairn.devices.tester.isolation' (measured 2026-10-09 at 8443ad5e; the import sat at :99 before the tooth's PROVES lines pushed it down). Outside measurement: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py seals green with its bytes unmoved. Hollow: restoring the import reds tooth (1). Wrong intent if: the proof's own mountinfo read cannot tell the swap from the live root (the tester would then publish a mount reading on its interface).
watchme: none, because the tester's interface proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py is the standing watch: every tester reseal re-measures it
